registration: Frozen before any v21 model training or test predictions; schema and cohort checks only observed
vocabulary: 128 most frequent distinct-per-case normalized drug names in initial 8000 training cases; stable lexical tie break; no test-derived labels
representation: Serialize gender/age and recorded prior orders plus numeric blood labs; word TF-IDF initial 8k min_df3 max16000 unigram/bigram; char_wb initial8k max24000 3-5grams for stronger controls
policy: Same v7 one-vs-rest SGD logistic selector: alpha1e-5, max60 iterations, tolerance1e-3; no LLM/API calls
memory: 30 nearest training contexts, similarity-weighted voting; all entries are from the training partition
order_tool: Same v7 conditional joint-order template model: max8 frequent tuples per drug, count>=10, >=80 records, SGD alpha1e-4 max40 iterations
output_budget: At most20 distinct drug names; each completed using a joint recorded training tuple
promotion: Maximize mean drug/order F1 on proposal. Promote only if the separate guard composite improves and each endpoint declines no more than0.002. Reject otherwise; all round states frozen before within-seed test scoring.
prevalence_and_prior_order_controls: Choose output count from1,3,5,8,12,20 on proposal using same composite. Prevalence uses40k training counts/global templates. Prior-order control preserves most recent known complete joint tuples, one per name, limited to common128-name output vocabulary.
ablation: Freeze one of policy/memory/tool to its initial8k artifact inside the final selected state; no retuning; conditional-dependence rather than optimal ablation claim
statistics: Independent saved-prediction recount; paired patient-cluster bootstrap2000 draws; drug/core-order F1 mean and sample SD over3 seeds; descriptive intervals, no multiplicity adjustment
limits: Retrospective raw-name agreement; not ATC/RxNorm benchmark equivalence
Supervised artifact evolution, not autonomous code or LLM-weight evolution
Repeated use of proposal/guard is adaptive development; new test patients remain untouched by selection
No claim to reproduce GAMENet/SafeDrug on this changed task
